comparison_scope: Retail structure recovered with Binary Ninja MCP disassembly, radare2 CFG and angr CFGFast; candidate structure measured on the pre-link COFF object built from the recorded source digest. The candidate is not linked into build-clean-win32/igi1.exe and no runtime initialisers were executed.

retail.bytes_sha256_scope: 0x00514680..0x00514759 read from the retail image (size 218 matches the Binary Ninja function boundary); digest of the function bytes, not of the whole image
retail.signature: int32_t* __cdecl Terrain_OutOfTerrainRenderch(const void* texture_owner, int32_t pass)

arguments.meaning: texture-owner key; only its 32-bit value is used in the hash
pass key blended into the bucket hash

return.meaning: matching chunk for (owner, pass), a newly allocated chunk, or the fatal path never returns

globals.role: 509-entry bucket table; each entry is 12 bytes {head, tail?, count?}; runtime-initialised at 0x00516621
slot-index array read at the element count
element capacity; fatal when count == capacity
offset from the element base to the slot-index dword (0x2EF4)

hash.formula: (uint32)(pass * 0xB5AF + owner * 0x9D) % 0x1FD, unsigned 32-bit modulo; intermediate products/add wrap
hash.evidence: 0x0051468B imul; 0x00514693 imul; 0x00514697 add; 0x0051469E xor edx,edx; 0x005146A0 mov eax,0x1FD; div

traversal.loop: node = head; do { next = [node+0x04]; if (next == 0) break; if ([node+0x2EEC] == owner && [node+0x2EF0] == pass) return node; node = next; } while (1)
traversal.sentinel: the sentinel chunk has next == 0; because next is tested before the owner/pass comparison, the sentinel is never accepted as a match

allocation.field_stores: element+0x00 = count (triangle_count); element+0x04 = owner; element+0x08 = pass; element+0x0C = 0; element+0x10 = 0; element+0x2EE8 = 0; element+0x2EEC = 0; element+0x2EF0 = 0
allocation.bucket_insert: 0x004AF910(bucket, element): old = bucket.head; element.prev = &bucket; element.next = old; old.prev = element; bucket.head = element

retail.fatal_path: push error text; call 0x004AF7B0; jmp $ (0x005146F9); bucket-table initialiser and count/stride/capacity globals must have run first
retail.binary_ninja: BN view_1: 9 blocks, 13 edges, 62 instructions; disassembly and decompile inspected
retail.radare2: af/afij: 9 blocks, 13 edges; node/edge sets identical to Binary Ninja
retail.angr: CFGFast exact entry recovered; blocks 11, edges 15, has_unresolved_jumps=false; approximate block partition (not compared block-for-block)

divergences.summary: Division by 0x1FD is strength-reduced to a reciprocal multiply.
divergences.impact: GCC's standard unsigned modulo rewrite; exact for all 32-bit inputs.
divergences.resolution: Proven algebraically and confirmed in the object disassembly.

divergences.impact: Same stores, same order, same head update; the helper return is discarded in both.
divergences.resolution: Store-by-store comparison of the inlined body against 0x004AF910.

divergences.summary: The candidate writes the zeroed pointer fields before triangle_count/owner/pass.
divergences.impact: Final memory state is identical; the chunk is unreachable through the bucket until the insert, so no observer can see the intermediate state.
divergences.resolution: Order difference recorded; no semantic effect.

divergences.summary: The element count is loaded once and returned rather than reloaded.
divergences.retail: count loaded at 0x005146DD and reloaded at 0x005146E2/0x0051471E
divergences.candidate: single load kept in a register
divergences.impact: Same value absent a concurrent writer; the function is not reentrant in retail either.
divergences.resolution: Difference is a value-preserving register optimization.

divergences.summary: Fatal call uses Error_Show instead of the Binary Ninja name Debug_Error.
divergences.impact: Same retail callee and halt. Error_Show may return, so the explicit loop is what preserves the retail hang.
divergences.resolution: Call target and halt match; the callee's no-return property is not statically proven.

divergences.retail: one ret at 0x00514759 shared by the match and allocate paths
divergences.impact: Same returned values; only block layout differs.

limitations: Static comparison only. No runtime capture, no memory/state observation and no rendered-output comparison was performed.

The measured candidate is the pre-link COFF object from engine/src/retail/terrain/terrain_out_of_terrain_renderch.cpp (sha256 bbee39aa...). build-clean-win32/igi1.exe does not contain this TU (CMakeLists.txt:76-79 excludes it; no symbol exists in the executable).
cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 score only; the candidate comparison in this file is source/object-level and is not reduced to a jaccard value.

The bucket table 0x00A7E080 and the pool globals 0x00A7F878/0x00A7F87C/0x00A7F880/0x00A7F884/0x00A7F888/0x00A7F88C are populated by runtime initialisers (0x00516621 and 0x00516640), which the comparison did not execute. With the file-image zero state the traversal and allocation paths cannot be exercised; the comparison covers the function body and its use of those globals, not a live pool.
The candidate stores the zero-filled file-image bucket table and does not run the 0x00516621 initialiser. Executing it before that initialiser runs is outside the compared scope.

The hash is unsigned modulo; the candidate's reciprocal multiply was proven identical for 32-bit inputs, but the record does not claim the two machines produce the same value for non-32-bit key sources (both arguments are 32-bit stack slots).
Error_Show (retail 0x004AF7B0) is variadic and may return; the candidate halts explicitly. The retail Debug_Error's non-return is not proven.

g_a7f88c is typed std::uint32_t consistently in the header, but the surrounding pool globals are defined in terrain_draw.cpp, which is also excluded from the build; the three terrain TUs still have no link configuration.

The source provenance comment still carries the pre-comparison TRANSCRIBED label and its Tools/evidence lines are wrapped, so scripts/native_gate.py emits non-blocking provenance warnings. The comment was not edited to avoid changing the source digest bound by this comparison.
Strict gate remains blocked: no semantic-review report bound to this implementation digest and no live behavioral runner exist for this TU.

status_recommendation.rationale: The retail entry, ABI, hash, bucket walk, capacity gate, slot/element arithmetic, all field stores, helper inlining, fatal path and both return values were compared against the compiled candidate. All observed differences are compiler artifacts with stated resolutions; no unresolved behavioural divergence remains in the compared scope.
